Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The success response to a vta/calendar/settings/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/calendar/settings/show/0.1#response.
Response.title: VTA Calendar — Settings — Show — response payload

TimeZoneId.description: An IANA time zone name, such as `Europe/London`, or `Etc/UTC`. A responder MUST refuse a name its time zone database does not know.
TimeZoneId.title: TimeZoneId

VtaCalendarContextId.description: A trust context of the VTA, by its identifier.
VtaCalendarContextId.title: VtaCalendarContextId

VtaCalendarDid.description: A DID: a community, or an identifier of the principal's.
VtaCalendarDid.title: VtaCalendarDid

VtaCalendarInstant.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds.
VtaCalendarInstant.title: VtaCalendarInstant

VtaCalendarQuietHours.description: A daily period in which the VTA fires no reminder (VTI-CAL-042), read in `timeZone`. A period whose `endsAt` is earlier than its `startsAt` runs past midnight.
VtaCalendarQuietHours.title: VtaCalendarQuietHours

VtaCalendarReminderList.description: Reminder offsets, distinct. Empty means no reminders.
VtaCalendarReminderList.title: VtaCalendarReminderList

VtaCalendarReminderMinutes.description: A reminder's offset: how many minutes before the event's start it is due. At most four weeks.
VtaCalendarReminderMinutes.title: VtaCalendarReminderMinutes

defaultReminderMinutes.description: Offsets for events that suggest none (VTI-CAL-041).

sync.description: Whether the VTA reads the events of the communities the principal belongs to in this context (VTI-CAL-010). False until the principal chooses.

updatedAt.description: Absent until the settings are first changed.

updatedBy.description: The party that last changed them (VTI-CAL-070).
